---
title: "Walk to Transit Analysis"
date: today
---

- only trips with walk mode as both transit access and egress modes are considered
- walking time inference: 3 mph = 15,840 feet/hour = 264 feet/minute

```{r}
# get data and load standard data processing
library(shiny)
library(leaflet)
library(tidyverse)
source("walk_to_transit_processing.R")

hts_source <- "Puget Sound Regional Council (PSRC) 2017-2025 Household Travel Survey"

```

```{r}
df_rail <- all_walk_transit_est %>%
  filter(transit_submode == "Rail") 

df_rail%>%
  summarise(n_na = sum(is.na(dest_stop_id)),
            n_est = sum(!is.na(dest_stop_id)))
```


```{r}
hist(all_walk_transit_est$acc_walk_min, breaks=100)
```


```{r}
plot(ecdf(all_walk_transit_est$acc_walk_min))
```
